name: Taj Mahal
tagline: Marble and gardens on the Yamuna
overview: Walk the formal gardens for views of the marble mausoleum and its river-facing terrace.

name: Agra Fort
tagline: A Mughal fortress above the Yamuna
overview: Red sandstone walls enclose courtyards, audience halls, and palaces built and adapted by Mughal rulers.

name: Fatehpur Sikri
tagline: Akbar’s former imperial capital
overview: Explore the sandstone palace precinct, stepped gateways, and the courtyards of the former capital.

name: Lucknow
tagline: Awadhi food and architectural heritage
overview: Pair the Bara Imambara and Rumi Darwaza with a walk through the food streets of the old city.

name: Sarnath
tagline: Buddhist archaeology near Varanasi
overview: See the Dhamek Stupa and excavated monastery grounds at the traditional site of the Buddha’s first sermon.

name: Jaipur
tagline: Palaces and bazaars in the Pink City
overview: Start in the walled city for the Hawa Mahal and market streets, then explore hilltop forts nearby.

name: Amber Fort
tagline: A hilltop palace above Maota Lake
overview: Climb through courtyards and decorated palace rooms for views over the lake and surrounding ridges.

name: Udaipur
tagline: Lakes and palace terraces
overview: Explore the City Palace and the streets around Lake Pichola, with viewpoints from both shores.

name: Jodhpur
tagline: Blue lanes below Mehrangarh
overview: Spend time in the fort museum and walk the blue-painted lanes and market around the old clock tower.

name: Jaisalmer
tagline: A sandstone city in the Thar
overview: The living fort and carved havelis make a natural pair with an excursion into the desert.

name: Pushkar
tagline: A lake town ringed by ghats
overview: Walk the lanes around Pushkar Lake and look for views from the hills above the town.

name: Ranthambore National Park
tagline: Dry forest and a hilltop fort
overview: Explore a landscape of forest, lakes, and ruins; wildlife sightings vary and park access is regulated.

name: Dholavira
tagline: A Harappan city on Khadir Island
overview: The archaeological site reveals a planned settlement with reservoirs, fortifications, and ceremonial spaces.

name: Champaner-Pavagadh Archaeological Park
tagline: Medieval monuments below Pavagadh Hill
overview: Combine the mosques and fortifications at Champaner with a visit to the hill if time allows.

name: Rani ki Vav
tagline: A sculpted stepwell in Patan
overview: The descending terraces frame elaborate stone sculpture and offer a close look at historic water architecture.

name: Modhera Sun Temple
tagline: A temple and stepped tank from the Solanki era
overview: Walk the temple complex from its ceremonial tank to the carved assembly hall.

name: Somnath Temple
tagline: A coastal pilgrimage stop
overview: The seafront temple area pairs walks by the Arabian Sea with the pilgrimage sites around Prabhas Patan.

name: Mumbai
tagline: Waterfront walks and Victorian streets
overview: Explore the harbour edge around Colaba and the historic civic buildings and markets near Fort.

name: Elephanta Caves
tagline: Rock-cut shrines on an island
overview: A harbour ferry and stepped approach lead to cave temples with large sculptural panels.

name: Ajanta Caves
tagline: Buddhist caves above the Waghora River
overview: Rock-cut halls and monasteries follow a bend in the gorge; several preserve remarkable murals.

photoCredit.author: No machine-readable author provided. Soman assumed (based on copyright claims).

name: Ellora Caves
tagline: Monumental architecture carved from rock
overview: Set aside time for the Kailasa temple and the Buddhist, Hindu, and Jain caves along the ridge.

name: Old Goa
tagline: Churches of the former Portuguese capital
overview: Explore the basilica and cathedral precinct beside the Mandovi River and leave time for the archaeology museum.

name: Dudhsagar Falls
tagline: A waterfall in the Western Ghats
overview: The falls descend through forest near the state border. Access routes and conditions can change seasonally.

name: Palolem Beach
tagline: A crescent bay in South Goa
overview: Walk the shore early or late and explore the viewpoints around this sheltered coastal bay.

name: Gokarna
tagline: Temple lanes and coastal trails
overview: Combine the old town’s temple precinct with paths between the headlands and beaches.

name: Mysuru
tagline: Royal architecture and a lively market
overview: Visit Mysore Palace and Devaraja Market, with Chamundi Hill an option for a separate outing.

name: Badami Cave Temples
tagline: Rock-cut temples above a reservoir
overview: The stairway above Agastya Lake leads to a series of shrines cut into red sandstone.

name: Pattadakal
tagline: Chalukya temples by the Malaprabha
overview: Compare the northern and southern architectural forms in this compact temple complex.

name: Jog Falls
tagline: The Sharavathi’s plunge into a gorge
overview: View the falls from designated viewpoints, where flow can vary widely with the season.

name: Madikeri
tagline: Coffee country in the Kodagu hills
overview: Use the town as a base for estate visits, ridge viewpoints, and short forest outings.

name: Belur
tagline: Hoysala stone carving on a grand scale
overview: Walk the Chennakeshava Temple enclosure and look closely at the reliefs and sculpted pillars.

name: Fort Kochi
tagline: Port history and seaside lanes
overview: Walk between the waterfront, historic churches, and neighbourhood streets shaped by long-distance trade.

name: Alappuzha
tagline: Canals and backwater villages
overview: Explore the waterways near Vembanad Lake by a local ferry or a small organized boat trip.

name: Munnar
tagline: Highland tea estates and misty valleys
overview: Start with the tea landscapes around town and choose a marked nature walk or nearby viewpoint.

name: Periyar National Park
tagline: Lake and forest in the Cardamom Hills
overview: Use Thekkady as a base for regulated walks or trips on the lake, with wildlife sightings dependent on conditions.

name: Varkala
tagline: Coastal cliffs above the Arabian Sea
overview: Follow the cliff-top path for views down to the beach and out over the Arabian Sea.

name: Mahabalipuram
tagline: Pallava monuments beside the sea
overview: Visit the Shore Temple, monolithic rathas, and open-air reliefs on foot across the town.

name: Brihadisvara Temple
tagline: A Chola temple in Thanjavur
overview: The temple’s tall tower, spacious courtyard, and carved stone are best seen on a slow circuit.

photoCredit.author: Original: Rainer Halama Derivative work: UnpetitproleX

name: Meenakshi Temple
tagline: A temple complex at the heart of Madurai
overview: Walk the streets around the gateway towers and see how the historic city grew around the temple.

name: Rameswaram
tagline: Pilgrimage and Pamban Island seascapes
overview: Combine the temple precinct with coastal views and a separate outing toward Dhanushkodi.

name: Ooty
tagline: Botanical gardens and Nilgiri viewpoints
overview: Visit the gardens and lake, or travel part of the hill railway for a different view of the landscape.

name: Kodaikanal
tagline: A lake town in the Palani Hills
overview: Walk the lake and the ridge viewpoints, leaving room for changes in visibility when clouds move in.

name: Kanyakumari
tagline: A headland at India’s southern tip
overview: Spend time on the seafront and look across to the offshore memorials; boat access depends on sea conditions.

name: Puducherry
tagline: Coastal streets and a historic promenade
overview: Explore the grid of streets near the promenade and the Tamil neighbourhoods farther inland.

name: Charminar
tagline: A monument at the heart of old Hyderabad
overview: See the monument from the surrounding bazaars and explore the streets leading to nearby historic buildings.

name: Golconda Fort
tagline: A fortified hill overlooking Hyderabad
overview: Walk the fort’s gateways and ascent for views across the masonry, ramparts, and city.

name: Ramappa Temple
tagline: A Kakatiya temple by a lake
overview: The sculpted pillars and carved stone brackets reveal the craftsmanship of the Kakatiya period.

name: Borra Caves
tagline: Limestone chambers in the Ananthagiri hills
overview: Follow the visitor route into the caverns, looking for stalactites and other formations along the lit path.

name: Tirumala Venkateswara Temple
tagline: Pilgrimage in the Seshachalam Hills
overview: The hilltop temple is a major pilgrimage destination. Check official arrangements before planning a visit.

name: Gandikota
tagline: A fort above the Pennar gorge
overview: Walk the fortified settlement and see the gorge from designated overlooks above the river.

name: Konark Sun Temple
tagline: A stone chariot on the Odisha coast
overview: Look for carved wheels, horses, and panels in the surviving complex of the temple to Surya.

name: Puri
tagline: Pilgrimage and a long Bay of Bengal shore
overview: Pair the town’s pilgrimage streets with time on the coast, checking temple access rules before visiting.

name: Chilika Lake
tagline: A brackish lagoon and bird habitat
overview: Choose a lake-side base according to the section you want to explore and travel with local boat operators.

name: Udayagiri and Khandagiri Caves
tagline: Rock-cut shelters above Bhubaneswar
overview: Climb the paths between clusters of excavated shelters and look for inscriptions and sculpted entrances.

name: Darjeeling
tagline: Tea slopes and Himalayan viewpoints
overview: Explore the hill town and its tea landscapes, keeping early starts for a better chance of clear mountain views.

photoCredit.author: Arne Hückelheim 2010-09-21 12:41:53 This is a cropped in which the glare has been lessened

name: Sundarbans National Park
tagline: Mangrove waterways in the Ganges delta
overview: Use permitted boat routes to explore the tidal landscape with local guides.

name: Victoria Memorial
tagline: A museum and gardens in Kolkata
overview: The building’s galleries and grounds make an easy pairing with a walk around the Maidan.

name: Bishnupur
tagline: Terracotta temples and craft traditions
overview: Walk between brick temples and examine the narrative reliefs that decorate their walls.

name: Mahabodhi Temple
tagline: A Buddhist pilgrimage site in Bodh Gaya
overview: Visit the temple precinct and Bodhi Tree, then explore the monasteries established nearby.

name: Nalanda Mahavihara
tagline: Monastic ruins of an early seat of learning
overview: Walk the excavated monasteries and temples to see how the residential and teaching spaces were arranged.

name: Sanchi
tagline: A hilltop group of Buddhist monuments
overview: Start with the Great Stupa’s carved gateways, then walk the paths linking monasteries and smaller stupas.

name: Khajuraho Group of Monuments
tagline: Chandela temples and sculpture
overview: Allow time for the temple clusters and the details of their sculpted exterior walls.

name: Bhimbetka Rock Shelters
tagline: Sandstone shelters with prehistoric paintings
overview: Follow the marked route through shelters and outcrops in the forested foothills.

name: Orchha
tagline: Bundela palaces on the Betwa
overview: The riverside cenotaphs, fort complex, and temple streets make a compact walking circuit.

name: Chitrakote Falls
tagline: A broad waterfall on the Indravati
overview: The river drops through a wide horseshoe-shaped edge, with very different views at high and low flows.

name: Kanger Valley National Park
tagline: Forested valleys and limestone caves
overview: Plan a route around the individual caves, forest walks, and waterfall sites that are open to visitors.

name: Hundru Falls
tagline: The Subarnarekha descends the Ranchi plateau
overview: Visit this waterfall from Ranchi and use the designated paths and viewpoints on the steep approach.

name: Deoghar
tagline: A pilgrimage town around Baidyanath Temple
overview: Explore the temple quarter and the streets that serve the town’s long-standing pilgrimage routes.

name: Golden Temple
tagline: A Sikh shrine surrounded by a sacred pool
overview: Walk the marble circuit and learn about the community kitchen. Cover your head and follow the site’s guidance.

name: Jallianwala Bagh
tagline: A memorial in the heart of Amritsar
overview: The garden memorial commemorates the people killed in the 1919 massacre and is reached through old-city lanes.

name: Qutb Minar
tagline: A soaring minaret and an early Delhi complex
overview: Walk the courtyards and ruined structures around the sandstone tower in Mehrauli.

name: Sultanpur National Park
tagline: Wetland birding near Gurugram
overview: Follow the designated perimeter paths to view waterbirds; conditions and bird numbers vary by season.

name: Rock Garden of Chandigarh
tagline: A sculptural maze made with reused material
overview: Paths pass courtyards, figures, and cascades assembled from discarded tiles, ceramics, and other materials.

name: Rishikesh
tagline: Riverfront walks in the Himalayan foothills
overview: Explore walking routes along the Ganges and the neighbourhoods associated with yoga and pilgrimage.

name: Kedarnath Temple
tagline: A pilgrimage site high in the Garhwal Himalaya
overview: The temple is reached by an uphill pilgrimage route in a high mountain valley; the visiting season is limited.

name: Valley of Flowers National Park
tagline: An alpine valley known for wildflowers
overview: The protected valley is reached on foot, with weather and seasonal trail access central to planning.

photoCredit.author: Original: Rohit Sharma Derivative work: UnpetitproleX

name: Nainital
tagline: A Kumaon hill town around a lake
overview: Walk between the lake shore, hillside lanes, and viewpoints above this mountain basin.

name: Shimla
tagline: A ridge town with colonial-era architecture
overview: Walk between the Ridge and Mall Road, then explore the steeper neighbourhood lanes and wooded trails.

name: Manali
tagline: A town above the Beas River
overview: Start with the old-town lanes and deodar groves, then explore accessible river and valley viewpoints.

name: McLeod Ganj
tagline: Tibetan culture in the Dhauladhar foothills
overview: Explore the monastery precinct, food streets, and marked walking routes around the hill town.

name: Great Himalayan National Park
tagline: Protected Himalayan forests and valleys
overview: Use the designated access points and plan permitted trails according to conditions and experience.

name: Srinagar
tagline: Lake, gardens, and the old city
overview: Combine the Dal Lake waterfront with Mughal gardens and a separate walk through the older city.

name: Gulmarg
tagline: A high meadow beneath the Pir Panjal
overview: Choose walks or winter activities based on snow and weather conditions, and use designated routes.

name: Leh
tagline: Palace terraces and a high-altitude old town
overview: Explore the old lanes below Leh Palace and the town’s hillsides at an unhurried pace.

name: Hemis Monastery
tagline: A monastery tucked in a tributary valley
overview: The courtyards and exhibition spaces make this an accessible introduction to Ladakhi monastic heritage.

photoCredit.author: Bernard Gagnon Canon EOS REBEL T4i

name: Kaziranga National Park
tagline: Floodplain grasslands with one-horned rhinos
overview: Use regulated routes through grassland and riverine habitats where rhinos and other wildlife live.

name: Majuli
tagline: A Brahmaputra island with monastic communities
overview: Allow time for river crossings and explore satras, village roads, and riverside landscapes.

name: Kamakhya Temple
tagline: A hilltop shrine overlooking Guwahati
overview: Climb or drive to the temple precinct on Nilachal Hill for views and a visit to an important pilgrimage site.

name: Dawki
tagline: A clear-water river at the southern border
overview: Visit the Umngot River from the town and look across the steep valley at the forested banks.

name: Tawang Monastery
tagline: A monastery overlooking the Tawang valley
overview: Explore the monastery courtyard, prayer hall, and viewpoints over the broad mountain valley.

name: Ziro
tagline: Rice fields and Apatani villages
overview: Walk valley roads between fields and settlements and learn about local farming traditions with a guide.

name: Loktak Lake
tagline: A lake known for floating vegetation
overview: Use the lakeshore viewpoints and regulated local routes to see the phumdis and surrounding hills.

name: Kisama Heritage Village
tagline: Architecture and traditions near Kohima
overview: Explore the village’s houses and performance spaces when open, with event schedules checked separately.

name: Reiek
tagline: A ridge high above forested hills
overview: Follow marked walking routes near the village for open views over the surrounding hills.

name: Neermahal
tagline: A palace in Rudrasagar Lake
overview: See the water palace and its setting from the lake shore or on an available local boat crossing.

name: Gangtok
tagline: A hill capital with monastery and ridge walks
overview: Explore the town’s ridge streets and use nearby monasteries and viewpoints to see the surrounding valleys.

name: Pelling
tagline: Monastery trails and mountain views
overview: Use the town as a base for the Pemayangtse monastery and the nearby ruins of Rabdentse.

name: Cellular Jail
tagline: A memorial to colonial-era imprisonment
overview: The galleries and surviving wings in Port Blair interpret the stories of prisoners held during British rule.

name: Swaraj Dweep (Havelock Island)
tagline: Forest-backed beaches in the Andaman Sea
overview: Explore the shore at Radhanagar and other designated beaches, with boat and water activity access dependent on conditions.

name: Agatti Island
tagline: A coral island with a shallow lagoon
overview: The island’s reef-fringed lagoon and beach walks are its main draws; check entry and transport arrangements before travelling.
